title: Renewal Triage Scratchpad and Simulation Plan
summary: Working scratchpad for a quick triage rubric, escalation cadence, and tabletop simulation plan for at-risk renewals. Purpose: accelerate decisioning, standardize exec asks, and produce reproducible save plays for CS/AE/SE.
body:
CONTEXT:
- This is an iterative working doc: notes, heuristics, sample comms, and a tabletop sim plan for practicing renewal saves. Not final; expect churn.

QUICK OBJECTIVES:
1) Standardize initial intake: fast risk score + recommended first-48h actions.
2) Define clear exec escalation asks (who, ask, expected outcome).
3) Maintain a small shelf of high-leverage save plays that are easy to spin up.
4) Run quarterly tabletop sims to keep the org practiced.

RISK SCORE RUBRIC (one-page, 0–20):
- Usage signal (0–6): trend of calls/throughput over last 90d (6 high usage/positive; 0 choking)
- Product fit (0–4): feature gap severity based on open items and roadmap alignment
- Financial exposure (0–4): ARR at stake and contract term remaining
- Relationship health (0–4): NPS/CSAT and number of engaged stakeholders
- Escalation urgency (+2): legal/Security/regulatory blockers or exec threats

Scoring notes: 14+ = high risk (auto-escalate). 9–13 = medium (CS + AE action within 7 days). <=8 = monitor but prepare play.

FIRST 48 HOURS PLAYBOOK (quick checklist):
- [ ] Triage call scheduled with AE/CS/SE within 24h
- [ ] Confirm contract dates and upcoming renewal window
- [ ] Gather 3 quantitative signals: token/usage delta %, errors/timeouts, active seats
- [ ] Identify top-3 feature gaps preventing success
- [ ] Agree immediate mitigation (hotfix, routing change, temporary quota boost)
- [ ] Draft exec escalation note if score >=14

SAMPLE EXEC ESCALATION TEMPLATE (concise, copy/paste):
Subject: [Action Requested] Renewal at-Risk: {Account} — Ask: Exec intro + 2-week strategic cadence
Body:
Hi {ExecName},

Quick note: {Account} (ARR ${ARR}, renewal {renewal_date}) surfaced high risk per CS triage (score {score}). Key drivers: {short bullets: e.g., latency spikes, missing SSO, roadmap mismatch}. Impact: risk of non-renewal and potential churn to competitor.

Ask: 30-minute intro call this week between you + their CTO/head of ML to commit to (a) prioritized integration owner and (b) a 6-week remediation plan.

Immediate mitigation already in flight: {list}.

Why exec help: they can unblock contractual procurement timelines and influence cross-org priority for the customer.

Thanks,
{CS Lead}

HIGH-LEVERAGE SAVE PLAYS (ready-to-deploy):
1) Fast Pilot Extension: 6-week extension with capped overages + dedicated SE hours (deliverable: migration checklist + telemetry dashboard).
2) SLA/Upsell Trade: Offer a short-term elevated SLA on critical endpoints in exchange for renewing on 12-month term.
3) Routing/Fallback Plan: Deploy lower-cost model variant in specific regions + prefix cache to reduce error surface (ops-runbook attached).
4) Co-funded PoC: Redwood funds part of an on-prem evaluation for regulated customers (requires Ops signoff).

DECISION TREE (textual):
- If score >=14 -> Exec escalation + AE/CS/SE immediate playbook; consider legal & SRE standby.
- If score 9–13 -> AE-led remediation; schedule 2-week tactical sprint, check in at week 2.
- If <=8 -> Monitor and quarterly QBR alignment.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES (shorthand):
- CS Lead: owner of customer relationship, compiles risk packet, runs triage call.
- AE: commercial lead, negotiates extension/terms, coordinates exec asks.
- SE: technical remediation owner, provides ETA for engineering fixes.
- SRE/Infra: supports rollback/routing and temporary increases in capacity.
- Legal/Finance: standing on short notice for concession approvals.

METRICS / SIGNALS WE WATCH (examples):
- Token calls per day (90d trend)
- Error rate and p95 latency by route
- # of open P0/P1 bugs mapped to customer features
- Support touch frequency and time-to-first-response
- Billing anomalies and disputed invoices

TABLETOP SIMULATION PLAN (quarterly, 90–120m):
- Prep (1 week): pick 2 recent at-risk accounts (anonymized) + prepare data packet.
- Day-of agenda (90m):
  - 0–10m: Context and stakes overview.
  - 10–30m: Triage run-through using the rubric (live scoring).
  - 30–60m: Assign play(s) and craft exec note + draft comms.
  - 60–80m: Rapid negotiation roleplay (AE vs customer) — test concessions.
  - 80–90m: Retro: what worked, slow points, decision friction.
- Outputs: finalized runbook per play, owner list for 48h actions, lessons log.

RUNBOOK EXAMPLE: Routing/Fallback Play (short):
- Trigger: p95 latency >1.5x baseline AND customer error rate >2% for 48h
- Triage owner: SE (cc CS/AE/SRE)
- Steps:
  1) Flip traffic rule to fallback-model for the customer's region (ops doc ID: OPS-987)
  2) Provision temporary warm instances (SRE) for 72h window
  3) Enable prefix KV cache for top 5 prompts
  4) Communicate to customer within 2h: "We implemented a temporary routing change to improve stability; we'll revert after validation."
- Rollback: when error rate <0.5% and p95 within baseline for 24h

NEGOTIATION PRINCIPLES (cheat-sheet):
- Keep concessions time-bound and measurable
- Tie product investments to mutual outcomes (e.g., milestones on roadmap)
- Prioritize high-signal wins (SLA, pilot extension, SE hours) over discounts when possible

TRACKER FIELDS TO INCLUDE IN RISK PACKET (spreadsheet columns):
- Account, ARR, renewal_date, score, top_risk_reasons, recent_comm_log, open_bug_ids, mitigation_play, exec_escalated (Y/N), next_steps, owner, links

QUICK LINKS / REFERENCES:
- CS standard contract concession playbook (confluence)
- Ops routing runbooks: OPS-986, OPS-987
- Legal shortcut approvals: LegalOps slack + template clause

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (working list):
- Define exact percentile thresholds for p95 latency that map to score buckets.
- Create a reusable Notion/Sheets template that pulls signals automatically.
- Train AE manager team on how and when to pull the exec lever (roleplay checklist).

NOTES TO SELF (fragmented):
- Could we automate initial risk score via internal analytics pipeline? (likely)
- Slack shortcut to create risk packet from account page (chatops)
- Need one-pager for Finance on concessions that explains lifetime value expectation vs short-term concession

END.
